page.overview:
What is 10 Downing Street?

10 Downing Street, colloquially known in the United Kingdom as "Number 10", is the headquarters of Her Majesty's Government and the official residence and office of the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.

The Mole-Man and his men planned the bombing of 10 Downing Street, in an attempt to eliminate Prime Minister Winston Churchill. However, with Captain America still hunting for them, the Mole-Man decided to bait a trap for the hero. While on the surface, Captain America and Bucky continued in their efforts to find the Mole-Man's secret hideout. As they were walking the streets as car passed by and tossed a note telling them the location of the Mole-Man's hideout. Knowing that they were walking into a trap, the two heroes went anyway as it was their only lead to stopping the Mole-Man. When they went to the address in the note, they got the drop on the thugs placed to attack them and beat them into submission. Cap then forced one of the Nazis to explain what was going on and led him to the bomb placed under 10 Downing Street. There, they were attacked by the Mole-Man and more of his men, who subdued them. When the Mole-Man was briefly blinded by the light of one of his minions' lanterns, Captain America knocked him and his men out. After alerting the British authorities of the spies' locations, Captain America rushed to 10 Downing Street and fought his way to the basement where he disarmed the bomb. With the crisis over, Captain America and Bucky were thanked personally by Winston Churchill for their heroic efforts.

Nick Fury met with Prime Minister James Callaghan to discuss the resurgence of Nazism. During an attempted invasion of Britain by the Red Skull, the Skull kidnapped Callaghan, but Callaghan was rescued by Captain Britain.

From the 10 Downing Street, Margaret Thatcher witnessed Magneto's declaration, demanding the world total political control in the seven days, and threatening them with the annihilation of all life.
